authority.choice_basis: Original fixed-pilot extent and implementation simplicity, before processing scores; no method-quality selection.
authority.controller_choice_record: ECEF→ENU 局部切平面：数学椭球 a=6378137, 1/f=298.257223563，h=0；中心bbox(121.343555,31.3561015)，source datum始终UNVERIFIED。

coordinate_order.source: Supplemental student lecture slide4, unchanged original hash in source_audit.json

analysis_assumptions.input_interpretation: Treat supplied angular pairs as coordinates on the explicitly chosen mathematical ellipsoid, conditionally and without a source-datum identification claim.
analysis_assumptions.origin_rule: Midpoint of the raw bounding box of all seven prescribed pilot records; freeze before processing and do not recenter after filtering.
analysis_assumptions.ellipsoid_label_limit: The constants specify a mathematical shape. They do not identify the teacher data as WGS84 or any EPSG CRS.
analysis_assumptions.coordinate_conversion: None for any WGS84/GCJ02/BD09 datum offset; only declared model ECEF/ENU derivation.
analysis_assumptions.Up_role: Optional diagnostic curvature coordinate, never observed altitude or terrain height.

mathematical_definition: Convert input longitude lambda and latitude phi from degrees to radians; f=1/inverse_flattening, e2=f*(2-f).
nu(phi)=a/sqrt(1-e2*sin(phi)^2). With h=0: X=nu*cos(phi)*cos(lambda), Y=nu*cos(phi)*sin(lambda), Z=nu*(1-e2)*sin(phi).
Compute (X0,Y0,Z0) at the frozen origin with the same formula and h0=0; let (dX,dY,dZ)=(X-X0,Y-Y0,Z-Z0).
All pipeline planar distances and finite-segment DP use (E,N). Grid heading is degrees(atan2(deltaE,deltaN)) modulo 360, consistent with the existing CLOCKWISE_FROM_POSITIVE_Y convention.

fixed_reference_pipeline.parameter_role: STARTER_REFERENCE, no parameter scan and no optimality claim
fixed_reference_pipeline.split_rule: Break before the right point iff dt>30 or model_distance>400; preserve original ordering, equality does not split, negative dt remains separately explicit.
fixed_reference_pipeline.filter_rule: After splitting, a segment is short iff point_count<5 or within-segment cumulative model_length<65; keep both reasons and never include a broken edge in length.
fixed_reference_pipeline.direction_rule: On each surviving input segment, compute outgoing directions once; an eligible interior point is marked only if BOTH circular differences to adjacent outgoing directions exceed 35 degrees; simultaneous deletion; endpoints and required undefined/zero-displacement windows retained and labeled; no iterative pass.
fixed_reference_pipeline.dp_rule: Finite Euclidean segment distance in the fixed working plane, original-index ordered subsequence, approved strict threshold behavior and existing fixed numerical review allowance; actual reference is the identical clean pre-simplification input.

independent_verification_plan.method: Compare production direct formula coordinates point-by-point with installed PROJ cart -> topocentric using only explicit a/rf/origin/h parameters; verify raw values and indices independently from the immutable JSON.
independent_verification_plan.tolerance_basis: 1 micrometer exceeds 512*binary64_epsilon*a (~0.725 micrometer) as a conservative ECEF subtraction/rotation check, fixed before comparison against the production adapter. It is only an adapter numerical crosscheck tolerance.
independent_verification_plan.not_allowed: Do not add this tolerance to split/filter/angle/DP processing thresholds or replace the preexisting DP audit allowance.
checks: All 783 points finite and ordered
Raw timestamp/lon/lat are exact copies
Origin maps to zero
Rotation is orthonormal
Same coordinates map to same E/N and remain zero displacement
Model/adapter/contract versions and hashes are candidate-external

independent_verification_plan.method: Record raw bbox, E/N/U range, maximum horizontal radius and distance to origin on the same mathematical ellipsoid. Check tangent-plane differential singular values 1 and abs(n dot n0) over the small bbox, and compare actual distances to independent ellipsoid geodesics.
independent_verification_plan.scope_limit: Local differential scale is not a finite-DP-chord error theorem. Model agreement is not a source datum or ground-truth proof.

independent_verification_plan.method: Recompute every raw delta from immutable times, preserving exact >30/equality rules and right-point ownership. Coordinates and model assumptions must not change temporal results.
independent_verification_plan.actual_equality_case: Record 1, original edge 0->1 has dt=30 and must not be split by time alone.

independent_verification_plan.method: For all 776 original in-record edges, record ENU distance, same-ellipsoid geodesic distance, margin to 400, distance-only boolean disagreement and combined time-or-distance split disagreement. Preserve the fixed ENU result.
independent_verification_plan.current_scope_result: A's full raw-edge diagnosis has zero disagreements and closest margin 3.418025911952043 model meters; not a replacement for final B output/C partition audit.
checks: Do not compare across records
Do not ignore equality
A time-triggered split does not conceal a geometric boolean disagreement in the sensitivity report

independent_verification_plan.target: 65 model-meter cumulative length and five-point filter
independent_verification_plan.method: Using each actual ENU-defined post-split segment, independently sum only its retained original adjacent edges in ENU and same-ellipsoid geodesic metrics; record lengths, absolute difference, margin to 65 and length-only/full-filter disagreement. Verify point-count<5 separately.
checks: No broken-edge contribution
Every filtered segment retains raw IDs and exact filtering reason
Both reasons may hold
Equality at five points/65 length is not less than the threshold
A point-count rejection must not hide a length sensitivity disagreement

independent_verification_plan.method: For each actual pre-denoise input segment, independently recompute outgoing ENU headings and BOTH circular differences with original indices. Record each difference's margin to 35, undefined reason and actual simultaneous deletion decision. To quantify representation sensitivity, map the same angular points once to same-ellipsoid fixed-center AEQD and evaluate those same windows only; do not rerun cleaning or select a better model.
checks: Use the same fixed-center axis convention when comparing projected headings
Do not compare ENU grid heading as if identical to a changing local geodesic north bearing
Zero displacement gives undefined, not zero heading
Do not introduce a centimeter/meter noise floor
No deletion-dependent iteration
Exact equality does not satisfy strict >35
independent_verification_plan.scope_limit: AEQD is a bounded independent geometric sensitivity check, not an alternate processing candidate. If the predicates differ, disclose model sensitivity; no tuning is authorized.

independent_verification_plan.method: First independently check every actual clean input point against the finite ENU segment between its corresponding retained original-index neighbors under the externally fixed 5m tolerance and existing numeric allowance. Then, as representation sensitivity only, map the same clean/final points to same-ellipsoid fixed-center AEQD and recompute finite-chord residuals for the same retained-index intervals; record maximum change and any 5m crossing.
checks: Clean-to-final reference only
Ordered original indices; no nearest segment elsewhere
Finite segment with clamped parameter, including degenerate segments
Compare all actual points, not only producer maxima
Never enlarge ENU tolerance because an alternate representation differs
Raw-to-final displacement and losses are reported separately
independent_verification_plan.scope_limit: Passing the ENU contract proves conditional model geometry. AEQD agreement does not establish geographic truth; differing AEQD residuals constrain cross-model claims but do not redefine the approved ENU algorithm.

independent_verification_plan.method: After the actual baseline C review, choose one observed case with greatest DP residual or smallest relevant threshold margin for targeted source-to-ledger/geometry recheck; B executes and C reviews the new product. If C finds an ordinary defect, repair and rebuild instead.
checks: Selection reason comes from actual output
No fabricated flaw or forced improvement
Keep fixed model/parameters
Record task/issue/artifact/version linkage

allowed_claims: The authorized teaching reference ran on the seven real input records under the frozen mathematical model
All original points and values are traceable
Finite-segment DP meets the stated tolerance in conditional model meters
Measured model sensitivity has the stated actual scope
forbidden_claims: Road alignment or absolute positioning accuracy
Consistency between two projections removes unknown source uncertainty
interpretation_contract.stop_scope: Only conclusions that require unresolved geographic facts are blocked; proceed with authorized conditional development and all ordinary engineering. Escalate only if the model cannot support even its explicitly conditional task, not merely because datum remains unknown.
